author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Is there anything useful Adam Savage learned from the MythBusters crew? Would Adam ever fund thousands in materials and labor upfront for a client, then wait for payment after proving progress? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members SilverDefender and Craftingtheunusual, whom we thank for their support!

Meet Adam in person! His upcoming appearances: https://www.tested.com/events
